item.title: Warm with more wild winds - Tuesday weather forecast
item.description: Good morning, Cape {town} Etc family. Here is your weather forecast for today, 2 December. Today’s weather in Cape Town features warm weather with wild winds, with a high of 26°C and a low of 18°C.It’ll be another scorcher with the UV index reaching a level of 9.

item.title: Cape Town family outings this festive season
item.description: Explore Cape Town’s top family outings this festive season, from botanical gardens and zip-lining to aquariums and glow-in-the-dark mini golf. Your ultimate holiday guide for fun, safe and enriching experiences.

item.title: Watch: Viral trend has young scholars parading medals
item.description: A new short-form viral trend shows predominantly young female learners laying out medals, trophies and certificates and filming the reveal for followers, reports Cape {town} Etc.

item.title: Blitzboks vow big Cape Town comeback after Dubai shocker
item.description: The Blitzboks returned from Dubai knowing they had work to do, and with the Cape Town leg of the SVNS Series just days away, the mood in the camp has shifted from frustration to fierce determination.

item.title: EFF moves to force inquiry into Cape Flats gang crisis
item.description: Parliament may soon be pulled directly into the heart of the Cape Flats’ gang-ravaged neighbourhoods after the Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) launched a new bid to confront the surge in deadly violence gripping the Western Cape.

item.title: R38m MyCiTi rollout delivers temporary jobs to Metro South
item.description: The City of Cape Town says six MyCiTi infrastructure projects in the metro-south east have generated 594 temporary work opportunities worth R38.1 million over the past two years, injecting cash into households and local businesses, reports Cape {town} Etc.

item.title: Mineral World, Scratch Patch & Cave Golf: A gem of a family adventure
item.description: Tucked along the scenic coastline of Cape Town's peninsula, Mineral World, Scratch Patch and Cave Golf have been delighting families and visitors for generations.

item.title: Simon's Town installs new camera traps to protect penguins
item.description: A new set of camera traps is set to transform monitoring efforts for the Critically Endangered African Penguins in Simons Town, reports Cape {town} Etc.
